decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf sits close to the core assortment and draws on existing recipes and production lines, so it costs little to carry; with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The historic mill tour builds on the firm's heritage and its existing event and café facilities, supporting the experience-based positioning, and slack from a growing market lets the firm carry it while results are still uncertain.
A sweet pastry is a low-risk extension of the traditional confectionery range, and with no signs of trouble it is unlikely to fall below aspiration levels enough to prompt dropping it within a year.
